title: Research: PR2809 NumericLease/SharedFrame interrupt-abort recovery audit (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independent audit of Jose Manuel / jmbarrancoml’s PR2809 `NumericLease` / `SharedFrame` interrupt-abort paths. The physical-contract map and PR2899 ordinary backend cover successful admitted execution, not interrupted-macro recovery; PR2809 itself excludes transactional recovery halfway through a parking-table command. This package pins those sources and supplies an independent phase algebra with semantic mutants.

At the pinned bytes: preparing-phase abort rolls both numerical banks back to the entry live sets; child-phase / SharedFrame construction interrupt uses `close(strict=False)`; `callee_returned` gates strict inventory on return versus interrupt; parking mid-command is explicitly outside the retained interruption contract. Three omission mutants show preparing rollback and strictness gating are load-bearing.

Complements just-open [#3993](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3993) (ScratchPool lease-end / CALL-empty on the successful path). Different primary modules (`numerical_frame.py` / `ordinary.py` vs scratch/CALL). Does not import the live NumericLease class, does not price park/restore, and does not close Callback.abort composition.

**No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/selected-bit-abort-recovery/`
- Tip: `235577cc62436e92aceb48450f2dc987c70b9c08`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — NumericLease/SharedFrame interrupt-abort only

Closest priors: PR2809; PR2899 successful-path disclaimer; [#3993](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3993) lease-end/CALL (complementary; harness kinship, distinct obligation). Soft overlap is a semantic successor on the interrupt module, not a lease-end reprint.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-bit-abort-recovery/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/selected-bit-abort-recovery/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-bit-abort-recovery/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-bit-abort-recovery/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-abort-recovery
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_ABORT_RECOVERY preparing_rollback child_interrupt_nonstrict return_vs_interrupt parking_out_of_contract three_mutants no_new_kappa
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_ABORT_RECOVERY_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-bit-abort-recovery outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Open next questions

1. Bind Callback.abort stack/residue rollback to the same interrupt invoice.
2. Compose interrupt discipline with lease-end/CALL-empty and residual/CALL into one enclosing ownership argument.
3. Supply a complete machine-step charge for park/restore on the interrupt path.
